Left out: Communicate the 40-hour burn time as a concrete value-for-money signal. — a duration claim needs a record that can establish "value", and the one(s) cited cannot.
Not on record: The lavender fragrance name or source (e.g. essential oil vs. fragrance oil, origin) is not on record — the owner could record: 'The lavender fragrance used is [name/type], sourced from [supplier/origin].'
Not on record: No candle size or weight is on record — the owner could record: 'The lavender candle weighs [X] grams / is [Y] cl.'
Not on record: No welcome-offer or discount for new subscribers is on record — the owner could record: 'New subscribers receive [X]% off / a flat ₹[X] discount on their first order.'
Removed "The candles are made from pure soy wax." — Fact says 'soy wax only' but not 'pure soy wax'—purity is more specific than the fact..
Removed "The candles are shipped directly to the customer's door." — Free shipping is mentioned, but not that candles are shipped directly to the customer's door..
Removed "The Lavender Candle is made from pure soy wax." — Fact says 'soy wax only' but not 'pure soy wax'—purity is more specific than the fact..
Removed "The Lavender Candle is shipped directly to the customer's home." — Free shipping is mentioned, but not that the Lavender Candle is shipped directly to the customer's home..

Left out: The core reason-to-believe for the email: our candles burn for 40 hours, which is the central claim the email is built around. — a duration claim needs a record that can establish "value", and the one(s) cited cannot.
Not on record: No record covers how our 40-hour burn time compares to a specific competitor or industry average. Owner to record: 'The average burn time of comparable candles on the market is ___ hours.'
Not on record: No record covers the specific wax grade or supplier used. Owner to record: 'We use ___ grade soy wax sourced from ___.' This would strengthen the material story.
Removed "Soy wax candles produce a cleaner burn than paraffin candles." — it compares with someone else's product, and nothing this business records about itself can establish that.
Removed "Soy wax candles have a slower glow than paraffin candles." — it compares with someone else's product, and nothing this business records about itself can establish that.
Removed "The entire candle-making process is done by hand in small batches." — Approved fact states 'Hand-poured in small batches' but does not state the entire process is done by hand — only the pouring is explicitly hand-done. Other steps (melting, fragrance addition) are described separately and not stated to be hand-done..

Left out: Walk the customer through what happens during the appointment — hair wash first, then treatment. — a process claim needs a record that can establish "process", and the one(s) cited cannot.
Not on record: Aftercare instructions for the keratin treatment (e.g., how many days to avoid washing hair, products to use or avoid) — record what the owner advises customers to do after the treatment.
Not on record: Business name or stylist name to personalise the welcome email greeting — record the trading name used with customers.
